panels.title: All links — throughput (bits/s)
panels.description: Every monitored hop from the Internet into the core, in one view. ▼in = toward the LAN, ▲out = toward the Internet.

panels.title: All links — errors + discards (per second) — should stay flat at 0
panels.description: Combined input+output errors and discards for every link. Any line lifting off zero is a real problem on that hop.

panels.title: Interface detail — speed, errors & discards (SNMP interfaces)
panels.description: Per-interface link speed and cumulative error/discard counters for the SNMP-monitored hops. Any non-zero error/discard cell turns red. Duplex is not shown (not in the if_mib SNMP walk); all links are switched full-duplex. The UXG Internet port is unpoller — see panels above.
